turns.text: Um but, I have noticed that when I am really focused on something important like maybe a something with work or a personal goal, I all of a sudden have no problem staying off my phone, right?
turns.zh: 嗯，但我注意到，当我真的专注于重要的事情时，比如工作上的事或者个人目标，我突然就完全能放下手机了，对吧？

turns.text: That tells me that it's not impossible.
I just need to redirect my attention.
turns.zh: 我只需要转移一下注意力。

turns.text: I need to be focusing on something else, not just on relaxing with my phone or being constantly on my phone.
turns.zh: 我需要专注于别的事情，而不是只靠手机放松或者一直盯着手机。

turns.text: So, for example, there was this time I decided to cut back on social media during the week.
turns.zh: 所以，举个例子，有一次我决定在工作日减少社交媒体的使用。

turns.text: Um I noticed that it was really interfering with work, and why don't I just put my phone down like you said, right?
turns.zh: 嗯，我注意到它真的在干扰工作，那为什么不就像你说的那样，把手机放下呢，对吧？

turns.text: Um you know, so I just I had to set a boundary, right?
turns.zh: 嗯，你知道吧，所以我只是……我得给自己设个界限，对吧？

turns.text: Uh first few days were a little bit tough, but when I made a clear rule for myself, no scrolling before 7:00 p.m., it actually worked.
turns.zh: 呃，头几天有点难熬，但当我给自己定了个明确的规矩——晚上7点前不刷手机——它还真管用了。
